name: UltraTech Cement Ltd

ledger.quote: We are expecting to complete the brand transition for these acquired assets, not later than June '26.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Due by June 2026, now past; the latest call and results don't say it was done.

ledger.quote: Our expansion plans are going on full swing, and we will complete or exit this financial year with 200 million tons of capacity under our belt.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Capacity target of 212 million tons by March 27 is pending.

ledger.quote: We expect delivery to start from January '26, and the plant should get commissioned in time for Q3 production launch.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.target: Q3 production launch for cables and wires
ledger.verdict: Commissioning and product launch occurred in Q3 fiscal 27 as promised.
ledger.evidence: On 3rd September this year, we launched our Wires and Cables business under the brand Ultravolt.

ledger.quote: However, by the time we complete the expansion, which is January March 28 or by the time the expansions are fully operational, the ICL assets will start generating EBITDA per ton of INR1,000 and a net debt EBITDA of around 0.5x.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: EBITDA per ton of INR1,000 targeted by January-March 28.

ledger.quote: The brand transition program, as I mentioned earlier, has already been completed to about 55% of its output, and we shall complete the rest of the program by the end of June '26.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Due by June 2026, now past; the latest call and results don't say it was done.

ledger.quote: Amit, so we are now sticking our program to reach about 240 - 245 million tons, which will get completed by fiscal '29.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Consolidated capacity target beyond 242 million tons by end of fiscal 27 is pending.

ledger.quote: We will reach about 65% of green power by the end of our current phase of growth.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.by_when: end of current phase of growth
ledger.verdict: Target of 65% green power is set for the end of current growth phase.

ledger.quote: I will have about INR10,000 crores minimum per year, outgo.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Capex guidance of INR8,000 crores to INR10,000 crores yearly applies to the foreseeable future.

ledger.quote: I believe and I'm very confident that we'll reach the mark of 1x and be in 0.8, 0.9x net debt EBITDA by the end of this fiscal year.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Net debt to EBITDA below 1x target for this year is pending as current ratio is 1.26x.
ledger.evidence: We are at 1.26x net debt EBITDA at the end of September '26.

ledger.quote: So, we should have approximately 8 to 9 million tons more coming in this quarter. And the balance,12 million tons in fiscal '27 and then balance remaining will be in '28.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.target: Add 8-9 million tons in Q4 and 12 million tons in FY27
ledger.verdict: Capacity addition schedule runs through fiscal 27 and 28.

ledger.quote: We shall give an exact quantification and financial impact with our annual results for the year.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.target: Quantification of efficiency impact with annual results
ledger.verdict: Quantification of efficiency impact is due with annual results.

ledger.quote: I would expect further generation of up to INR500 crores minimum, which we should be able to get.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.target: Generate minimum INR500 crores from non-core assets
ledger.verdict: Non-core asset generation has no specified deadline.

ledger.quote: And our renewal energy has gone to almost 41% kind of thing, and it is further likely to go to 60% going forward actually.
ledger.speaker: K.C. Jhanwar
ledger.verdict: Green energy share target by FY27 or first half of FY28 remains pending.

ledger.quote: We have committed to reach about 85% of our power requirements from green energy by the end of fiscal 2030, and we are very confident of reaching that position.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Power from green energy target of 85% by end of fiscal 2030 is pending.

ledger.quote: We expect a sustainable volume growth of 7% to 8% per annum.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Volume growth of 7% to 8% per annum has no specific deadline.

ledger.quote: We'll maintain our leverage below 1x year after year after meeting our growth capex.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Leverage maintenance below 1x year after year is ongoing.

ledger.quote: We have targeted to reach about 1.54x. That road map is already there and let's see how things shape up beyond that.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Clinker conversion ratio target of 1.54x by fiscal 28 is pending.

ledger.quote: We are targeting double-digit volume growth this year.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Double-digit volume growth target for this year is pending.

open.quote: We are on track to reach 240 million tons of capacity as planned without any surprises.
open.speaker: Kailash C. Jhanwar

open.quote: And the balance will get spent in the next maybe 2 quarters.
open.speaker: Atul Daga

open.quote: By the end of March, I will be below 1x net debt to EBITDA.
open.speaker: Atul Daga

open.quote: We will come with our detailed plans before the end of this financial year.
open.speaker: Atul Daga

open.quote: We will not stop before 10,000 stores, which should happen in the next 3 years which is 28-29, we should be reaching about 10,000 stores.
open.speaker: Atul Daga

open.quote: What I can promise is that we will manage it much better than anybody else under the sun.
open.speaker: Kailash C. Jhanwar

open.quote: With that, capacity of 78,000 tons of copper consumption on an annualized basis, we are already number two in our space.
open.speaker: Atul Daga

open.quote: Remaining power and control cable lines will be commissioned through the second half.
open.speaker: Kailash C. Jhanwar

read: Management delivers on commercial launches like Ultravolt on time, but debt targets face slippage with net debt to EBITDA at 1.26x versus the 0.8-0.9x guidance.
questions: Why did net debt to EBITDA reach 1.26x against the 0.8-0.9x target?
When will the leverage ratio drop below 1x as previously guided?
bull: Operating profit rose to INR3,719 crores in Sep 2026 from INR3,089 crores in Sep 2025.
Green power share reached 47% of power needs.
bear: Net debt to EBITDA increased to 1.26x at the end of September 2026.
Fuel costs rose from INR45 to INR51.5 per bag due to West Asia crisis.
